'''Takara Korsin''' was the mother of [[Yaru Korsin]], making her the grandmother of [[Nida Korsin|Nida]]. Yaru had the [[Takara Mountains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] named after her.
